drawing_facts.relationship: The floor plans show parallel east-west flights connected by an east half-landing; each storey must be analysed independently.

floor_logic.floor_1: Lower flight starts at the west side, rises east to the half-landing, then returns west to floor 2.
floor_logic.floor_2: The same dogleg system rises from floor 2 to floor 3 and remains visible when reviewing floor 3.
floor_logic.floor_3: Only the arrival landing and short protective guard are owned by floor 3; the descending flight remains owned by floor 2 to avoid duplicate geometry.
